def parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = self.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end
